english: ...So you finally came. The one who called this meeting\nbeing late is hardly commendable.
Sooorry, Jeanne!\nSneaking around takes\nquite a bit of effort, y'know.
I assume you know,\nbut I.U. is reconsidering\nits relationship with Mii and Kei.
I know.\nBut I've still got some\npersonal business to take care of.
Is that why you called me here?
Pretty much.\nThis time it's intel in exchange\nfor a favor. You in?
Intel... Heh.\nIf it were intel on your whereabouts,\nAria would pay dearly for it.
Grant me any three wishes\nand I'll tell you.
A joke.
Wow! Jeanne telling jokes—\nnow that's a rare sight!
Is it? ...No, perhaps I've been\ninfluenced by that bunch.
They're nothing like I.U.,\nbut I don't dislike them.
Hmm, sounds like you're having fun.
That aside, let's get to the point.
Then, as a freebie, the intel first.\nMii and Kei should be coming\nto stir up trouble on your end soon.
Oh? When?
It's Mii we're talking about. Who knows?\nI'll look forward to seeing how you handle it.
And in return, you want?
Well...
//fade to black\n//Event CG: Mii playing in the pool
Kyahahahaha!!\nSwimming is such a paaain!!
Humans are weird.\nWhy go out of your way to do this stuff?
Wearing these goofy clothes.\nA school swimsuit, was it?\nIt's not cute at all!
When I invited Kei-chan to go swimming,\nshe just went "incomprehensible" and wandered off.
Oh, maybe Kei-chan's too heavy to swim!\nI wanted to see her going\n"bubbling down, cannot flooat"!
Maybe she's secretly shy?\nAhahahaha♪
//fade to black\n//Background: Butei High classroom
The black IS, the Symphogear, and Kei.\nStill no word on any of them?
...I've had every Butei High department\nlook into it, but\nthere's no solid intel at all.
Kei aside, where did those black ones\ndisappear to?\nCould they be ghosts or something?
Since neither I nor Rem-san have sensed\nanything like that,\nI don't think so.
Rem mentioned something about doppelgangers—\nyou know, those lookalike monsters\nshe talked about.
Black lookalikes are popping up\nin worlds everywhere, desu~!
The scary part is, those black ones\nshow up anywhere.\nWhere do they even come from?
I wonder how they travel between worlds.\nThey don't seem connected\nto Mii and Kei, though...
Doesn't look like they're using a Poryal.\nUnless there are more Poryals\nin places we don't know about.
There's also that Doctor Shinigami,\nso perhaps our world connects somewhere\nto a place like the demon realm.
The strange happenings at the hot-spring inn\nremain a mystery as well!
I'd like to say that's ridiculous, but\nit's a fact that plenty of things\nscience can't explain keep happening.
I don't think the black people are\nsomething in disguise.
They don't seem to be machines either.
So what ARE they? That's the question.
Then we'll just have to catch one.\nLet's think of a way to lure them out.
No, that won't be necessary.
Jeanne! Where have you been!?
Now, listen.\nIt seems Mii and Kei will be\ncoming after us soon.
Where'd you dig up that scoop?
That's...
//Screen shake & flash, explosion sound
What!?
...The intel was already stale.\nThat Riko...!
//Battle map: Butei High\n//Meru (Noel), Houki, and Chris force-deployed.\n//Kei and many grunts deployed.
Target position confirmed.\nSystem: switching to combat mode.\nPreparing ground encirclement.
This many enemies...!
Are they after the Akatsubaki?
Disclosure of information judged acceptable.\nObjective: Kenran Butou, and confirming\nthe IS's sustained combat capability.
If you're spilling that much,\nyou're basically looking down on us!
Judged beneficial to achieving the objective.\nThat is all.
It seems I'm not even worth noticing.
I have no interest in one\nwhose holy sword Durandal was broken.
Durandal was not lost.\nReforged, it remains here with me.\nI won't be underestimated.
Whatever she's plotting,\nI'll punch a hole right through it!
Everyone, stay calm.\nWe don't know what else might show up.
Kei! Our paths cross at last!\nTime to repay you for toying with me!!
Yukine Chris's statement contains an error.\nI have never engaged in\nthe act of "playing."
Don't play dumb, you tin can!
I must correct the error again.\nAt the very least, I am not a "bastard."
Ugh! You're annoying beyond belief!\nStrutting around on those obsolete specs!!\nThat's what makes it the worst!!
Calm down, Chris.\nWhy not take a page from Hibiki?
I'll just convey my feelings!\nBy any means necessary!
What a look. I think I'm falling for you all over again.
All right, let's go!
//Battle start.\n//Enemy reinforcements (a few) at the start of turn 2.
They're already here!
Maybe they're trying to wear us down\nand force Kenran Butou to activate?
Unfortunately, we still don't know how to activate it.
The ones that just showed up are pretty too, desu~.\nCandidates for my collection, desu~!
[MERU]-san!\nSave that for when we have breathing room!
Being worn down bit by bit is nice too... ufufu!
Hey! What's with that look!?
Why's she looking so happy?
B-best not to think about it!
//Event below triggers after defeating several of the initially deployed grunts.
More of them!\nBut now that the energy problem is solved,\nthe Akatsubaki has no blind spots!
Not yet...
//Event below triggers after defeating several more enemy grunts.
Ugh, they're persistent!\nWhere do they keep coming from!?
Truly, no end in sight.
This is getting a little tough, desu~...
Ufufu... being worn down\nbit by bit... feels good...
Wh-what a weirdo...
...Time to move.
//The Master and the Rival appear.
New readings!? That's!!
Teacher! And [NOEL] too!?\nDid you come to save us, desu~?
Teacher! And [MERU] as a bonus!\nDid you come to save us!?
Foolish.
N-no way...
I-I knew it...?
Do it.
Yes! Teacher!
Yes, desu~!
Eve, you've joined forces with Kei?
You don't need to know.
[NOEL]-san,\nthere's no one among us\nwho wants to fight you.
Why won't you answer...!
[MERU]-chan!\nWe're friends! We don't need to fight!
I see... words won't reach you.\nGot it!
Warning. Eve: unauthorized combat intervention\nwill be deemed a hostile act.
[MERU] is a traitor.\nI have the right and duty to dispose of her.\nWe have already discussed this.
A traitor... me...?
[NOEL] is a traitor.\nI have the right and duty to dispose of her.\nWe have already discussed this.
Traitor!? That's a bit much!?
Mission plan partially revised.\nOnly the disposal of the targets is authorized.
(Good...)
That works.\nThe rest of you aren't worth my notice.
That outrageous woman!!
(No, this is unnatural... Why now?\nThere must have been plenty of other chances\nto go after their lives...?)
That's strange.\nDoes it have to be right now, kana? Kana?
//Battle resumes.\n//Talk event when Eve or the Rival engages a heroine.
Don't resist, and you'll die easy.
Confirming Eve's combat actions.\nClassifying as execution behavior.
(...Good.)
Teacher! Why are you doing this, desu~?
Teacher, do you hate me that much?
Shut up and die.
You should die by the Teacher's hand.
I should be disposed of by the Teacher, desu~!
Since you defied my orders,\nyour will deserves to be ignored.\nWhat a fool needs is not a teacher, but death!
This is all strangely theatrical, isn't it?
(This exchange is unnatural...\nWhat are they after...?)
//Event upon defeating Eve and the Rival.
Persistent, aren't you.\nIn honor of that tenacity, I'll withdraw for now.
Wait, desu~!\nWhy do we have to fight, desu~!\nAt least tell me why, desu~!
[MERU], the real enemy is...
Hold on!\nWhat are the Teacher and [MERU]\neven trying to do!?
Figure it out already, desu~!\nThe enemy is...
Silence.
Y-yes!
Eep! I'm sorry, desu~!
We're going.
//Eve and the Rival vanish.
Are they hiding something, desu~...?
What is it!? This doesn't sit right!!
//Event after dealing a set amount of damage to Kei or after several turns.\n//SE: Kei's alert sound
Error detected. Scanning all systems.\nProblem detected.
What? What's wrong!?
Cooling system anomaly.\nHeat-induced drop in processing speed, control lag.\nContinued combat judged problematic.
Wh-what!?
Looks like they were worried\nabout a long battle too.
The price of high performance, eh?
Is that why she's interested in Kenran Butou?
Withdrawing from combat area.
//Kei and the grunts vanish.
An unexpected weakness, wasn't it?
So she pushed herself every which way\nto get that performance.
It'll be interesting to see\nwhat shape she's in next time she shows up.
//Battle ends once Eve and Kei are gone from the map.
...She fled at incredible speed.\nSomehow, it seemed almost... hurried.
Your imagination, no?\nI doubt she has such feelings.
Well, that worked out somehow.
//Riko arrives.
Hii! Good work, everyone!
Riko!? To make your move\nat this timing... you've got nerve!
Riko's a phantom thief who appears out of nowhere!
Anyway, setting that aside!\nJeanne, was my intel useful?
Unfortunately, it just barely didn't make it in time.
Jeanne! Don't tell me\nyou got the Kei intel from Riko!?
That's right.\nRiko and I are close, even within I.U.
So the one who got close to us\nwas a spy!?
No. Quite the opposite.
So, Riko Mine, you betray Mii and her lot too?
Betray?\nRiko just used them.\nI don't recall ever joining them.
That doesn't matter!\nI'll arrest you and make you testify\nabout Mama's false conviction in the Supreme Court!
Okay.
By force if I— ...huh?
As the "Butei Killer," I'll testify.\nBut not for free.
I don't need to hear your terms!\nI'll arrest you and that's that!
...Aria loves her mama, huh.\nI get it — Riko loves her mother too.
Motheeer... waaahhh!
Huh? Wh-what?
What's going on!?\nC-calm down!\nStop crying and explain! I'll listen!
(That reeks of lies.)
(Those tears are for show.)
(But we might squeeze some\nnew information out of her.)
It's not my place to say,\nbut could you hear Riko out?
Let's hear her out!
I owe Riko a debt from Kagami.\nI think we can at least hear her out?
If you all say so.
Thanks... Okay, I'll talk.
(She just smirked!)
(She just smirked, right?)
(That face just now...)
//fade to black: time passes
Your mother's keepsake rosary was stolen...?
It's precious — my mother gave it to me.\nTo get it back, Riko was\nonly pretending to help them.
Riko's rosary is worth more than\nall the Lupin family's other treasures combined.
What an amazing treasure!\nThough I have no idea\nhow amazing it is!
I'd heard the rosary was stolen by\nsomeone in I.U., but\nto think it ended up in Mii's hands...
If I can just get the rosary back,\nRiko will do anything!\nEven testifying for Aria's mama!
So, what would you have us do?
Umm, what I want from everyone is...
Make a contract with me\nand become my maids!!
Whaaaaaaaaaaaaat!?
//fade to black\n//Background: a weird place. Blue sky is fine.\n//Mii talks to Kei, who has returned.
Aw, did Kei-chan mess up?
//Event CG: Kei, leaking water
Anomaly in the enhanced cooling system.\nCoolant is leaking.
Ahahahaha!! You're soaked!
Cause: the continuous-operation limit of ultra-high-speed combat computation\nwas shorter than the theoretical value.
As expected, without measured data,\na stable system cannot be built.
So, so?\nHow was the Akatsubaki? Think we can use it?
The energy from the Akatsubaki's Kenran Butou\nis currently judged non-transferable outside an IS.\nI recommend removing it from our priorities.
Hmm... so it's a no-go.
//Event CG off.
Mii, please present the next course of action.
Our next fun is all ready!\nNyufufu!!
//END
